title: Energy Oman and ExxonMobil sign concession agreement
summary: To advance Greater Makarem Gas Development and LNG Opportunity in Duqm

Energy Oman and ExxonMobil have signed a Concession Agreement with the Government of the Sultanate of Oman for the development of natural gas resources in the Greater Makarem Field (Block 20). Image courtesy: Energy Oman

To advance Greater Makarem Gas Development and LNG Opportunity in Duqm

Press Release

Energy Oman and ExxonMobil have signed a Concession Agreement with the Government of the Sultanate of Oman for the development of natural gas resources in the Greater Makarem Field (Block 20), paving the way for an integrated gas development and liquefied natural gas (LNG) project, with LNG facilities to be established in Duqm. 

The project represents an important step in unlocking the potential of Oman's natural gas resources and converting them into long-term economic value. By integrating upstream gas development with LNG production, the project will strengthen Oman's position in the global gas and LNG markets, enhance its capacity to serve international demand, and create new opportunities across the energy and industrial sectors. 

Located in Duqm, the proposed LNG facilities will benefit from the area's strategic geographic position, expanding industrial ecosystem and growing infrastructure. The project will further reinforce Duqm's role as an emerging hub for energy-related investment and industrial development, while creating opportunities for local businesses, employment and the wider national economy. 

For Energy Oman, the project marks a strategic step in expanding its presence across the gas value chain and advancing its ambition to maximise the value of Oman's hydrocarbon resources. It reflects the company's continued focus on developing commercially attractive energy opportunities, building strategic international partnerships and supporting the sustainable growth of Oman's energy sector. 

ExxonMobil brings global expertise and advanced technology to help develop Oman’s sizeable unconventional gas resources and support the delivery of a world-class energy project. The partners will work towards delivering a world-class project that supports Oman's long-term energy ambitions, strengthens its contribution to global energy markets and generates lasting value for the Sultanate.

About Energy Oman

Energy Oman was established by Royal Decree in December 2020 via the legal entity Energy Development Oman SAOC, becoming Oman’s national energy company.  Tasked with leading the nation’s energy sector, its core objective is to ensure efficient, secure, and cost-effective energy for national prosperity in line with Vision 2040’s economic growth goals. Energy Oman’s mandate is to optimise the commercial potential of Block 6 where it holds a 60% stake in the oil concession and 100% ownership of the gas concession.  A key enabler in Oman’s energy transition journey, Energy Oman aims to balance the reliance on traditional hydrocarbons with renewable energy, including solar and wind.   

Energy Oman’s strategy encompasses the oversight of energy assets in Block 6, optimising its operating models and the consolidation of its procurement and supply chain processes. Energy Oman is focused on the management of the assets to improve cash-flow as well as identifying and structuring new income-generating opportunities.  With these initiatives, Energy Oman is bolstering Oman’s energy security and providing a steady revenue stream for the government. Fostering a supportive ecosystem for the energy industry, Energy Oman works closely with the public and private sector to establish an enabling regulatory and business framework for foreign investment in green energy initiatives. This collective effort is instrumental in achieving the nation’s 2050 net-zero goals and building a low-carbon future.
